summary: Implemented rich.progress.open and rich.progress.wrap_file, plus Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods, across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. All changes are additive and nothing is committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per the instruction not to run repository code, so verification is by reading only. Review points: the reader adds mode, name, and truncate because typing.IO marks them abstract; the module-level open return-value/type-variable suppression from the spec was not added and mypy may flag it; buffering-forwarding test monkeypatches io.open.
